title: Q-Max 液化天然氣船
summary: 以Q-Max液化天然氣船級名稱作低溫大型運輸案例，重點在貨物能量和船舶能量分開核算；不把教學潛熱或效率視為同名船型實際值。 各單元為獨立縮尺練習，串接的是驗證流程，不是同一實船的校準數位分身。
summaryEn: Use the Q-Max class as a large cryogenic-transport case, accounting separately for cargo energy and vessel energy without treating assumed latent heat or efficiency as class specifications. Units are independent scaled exercises connected by a verification workflow, not a calibrated digital twin of one vessel.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的原創船舶海洋教學。數值均為明示假設，不是同名船舶的實測規格、法規認證或實船操作參數。以虛構資料、教學模型與常壓桌面練習學習，排除武器、戰術與載人下潛操作。
scopeEn: Original marine teaching based on public principles. All numbers are explicit assumptions, not measured named-vessel specifications, certification criteria or real-ship operating parameters. Learning uses synthetic data, teaching models and unpressurized desktop exercises, excluding weapons, tactics and crewed diving operations.

steps.title: 定義貨物運輸功能單位：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Define cargo-transport service: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 定義貨物運輸功能單位 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Define cargo-transport service and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 定義貨物運輸功能單位：噸公里是載重乘距離，可比較同一服務量的能源需求；空載回程會改變整個任務帳。 本步以「載運功能單位與效率」對應案例介面，先標記輸入、輸出與未計入項目。
steps.instructionEn: Define cargo-transport service: Tonne-kilometres are payload times distance and compare energy for equal service; empty return legs change the mission ledger. Use Transport functional units and efficiency to describe the case interface, marking input, output and omitted terms first.
steps.observation: 各單元數值是獨立練習，不能合併成同一實船的質量或能源帳。本單元獨立的原創縮尺教學資料，不是Q-Max 液化天然氣船實際規格：貨物m=1060 t、距離d=500 km。式 Wtransport=md，基準結果 530000 t·km。條件：單程貨重距離指標，不是機械做功，也未含空載和港口能耗。
steps.observationEn: Numbers in different units are independent exercises and cannot be combined into one vessel mass or energy ledger. Independent original scaled data for this unit, not actual specifications of Q-Max LNG carrier: Cargo m=1060 t, distance d=500 km. Formula Wtransport=md gives 530000 t·km. Conditions: One-way payload-distance indicator, not mechanical work; empty legs and port energy excluded.
steps.failure: 只用最大載重而非實際載重會美化每噸公里指標；需核對裝載率。 若案例資料尚缺，先標為未驗證，不能用同名船舶的外觀照片填補數值。
steps.failureEn: Using maximum rather than actual payload artificially improves per-tonne-kilometre metrics; inspect utilization. Mark missing case data as unverified rather than filling values from a photograph of the named vessel.
steps.check: 分別填裝載與空載航段的燃料和距離，使用同一邊界比較不同船型。 本案例另須檢查「定義貨物運輸功能單位」與前一步資料是否使用同一時間、單位與系統邊界。
steps.checkEn: Log fuel and distance for loaded and empty legs separately and compare vessels under a common boundary. Also check that Define cargo-transport service and the preceding step share time, units and system boundaries.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 本單元任務：定義貨物運輸功能單位。在貨艙與推進系統邊界圖、低溫熱流與質量帳完成資料或紙面模型練習。只增加貨物質量10%，保持距離，算服務量；不得假設能耗必不變。 算式區的基準值為530000，改變後為583000 t·km。先預測方向，再計算、記錄原式與新式，最後寫下仍需量測的資料。
knowledge.textEn: Unit task: Define cargo-transport service. Complete a data or paper-model exercise at the Cargo/propulsion boundary diagram, cryogenic heat-flow and mass ledger. Increase payload alone by 10%, retain distance and calculate service without assuming unchanged energy. Baseline 530000 changes to 583000 t·km. Predict direction, calculate, retain both expressions and record the measurement still needed.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「Q-Max 液化天然氣船」的「定義貨物運輸功能單位：機制與觀察」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出船模、排水體積、能源、感測與觀測資料的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「海上能源：岸電交班」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與配重表、排水量、聲速或時間戳、原始量測與模型尺度的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Define cargo-transport service: Mechanism and observation” in “Q-Max LNG carrier”. Draw the model vessel, displaced volume, energy, sensors and observation-data boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Offshore Energy: Shore-Power Handoff” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for ballast manifest, displacement, sound speed/timestamps, raw data and model scale, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

steps.observation: 各單元數值是獨立練習，不能合併成同一實船的質量或能源帳。本單元獨立的原創縮尺教學資料，不是Q-Max 液化天然氣船實際規格：ρ=1025 kg/m³，排水體積V=530 m³。式 m=ρV，基準結果 543.25 t。條件：僅靜水質量平衡；不等於總噸位，也未判定完整穩度。
steps.observationEn: Numbers in different units are independent exercises and cannot be combined into one vessel mass or energy ledger. Independent original scaled data for this unit, not actual specifications of Q-Max LNG carrier: ρ=1025 kg/m³, displacement volume V=530 m³. Formula m=ρV gives 543.25 t. Conditions: Static mass balance only; this is not gross tonnage and does not establish intact stability.
steps.failure: 把總噸位當質量會混淆容積指標與重量，先檢查資料欄位定義。 若案例資料尚缺，先標為未驗證，不能用同名船舶的外觀照片填補數值。
steps.failureEn: Treating gross tonnage as mass confuses a volume-based index with weight; inspect field definitions first. Mark missing case data as unverified rather than filling values from a photograph of the named vessel.
steps.check: 以四欄裝載表加總後與排水質量比對，標出尚未計入的人員、淡水與備品。 本案例另須檢查「分開貨艙設備與液體質量」與前一步資料是否使用同一時間、單位與系統邊界。
steps.checkEn: Sum a four-column loading table and compare with displacement mass; flag omitted people, freshwater and spares. Also check that Separate containment equipment and liquid mass and the preceding step share time, units and system boundaries.

knowledge.title: 分開貨艙設備與液體質量
knowledge.titleEn: Separate containment equipment and liquid mass
knowledge.text: 把總噸位當質量會混淆容積指標與重量，先檢查資料欄位定義。 若案例資料尚缺，先標為未驗證，不能用同名船舶的外觀照片填補數值。
knowledge.textEn: Treating gross tonnage as mass confuses a volume-based index with weight; inspect field definitions first. Mark missing case data as unverified rather than filling values from a photograph of the named vessel.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 本單元任務：分開貨艙設備與液體質量。在貨艙與推進系統邊界圖、低溫熱流與質量帳完成資料或紙面模型練習。只增加排水體積10%，重算可平衡的質量，不推定可額外載客。 算式區的基準值為543.25，改變後為597.575 t。先預測方向，再計算、記錄原式與新式，最後寫下仍需量測的資料。
knowledge.textEn: Unit task: Separate containment equipment and liquid mass. Complete a data or paper-model exercise at the Cargo/propulsion boundary diagram, cryogenic heat-flow and mass ledger. Increase displacement volume alone by 10% and recalculate equilibrium mass without inferring additional passenger capacity. Baseline 543.25 changes to 597.575 t. Predict direction, calculate, retain both expressions and record the measurement still needed.

quiz.explanationEn: Treating gross tonnage as mass confuses a volume-based index with weight; inspect field definitions first. Also check that Separate containment equipment and liquid mass and the preceding step share time, units and system boundaries.
